ff_sunflower_oil.reason: Previewed two: a labelled supermarket bottle (brand label, nutrition panel, barcode) and a torange.biz styled shot whose subject is a sunflower head with a corner watermark. Other hits were branded bottles, a street vendor (person), a production map and bottling-date close-ups. No plain unlabelled sunflower oil found.

ff_corn_oil.reason: The only photo titled 'Corn oil (mais)' is a branded 5-litre supermarket bottle on a shelf (rejected). 'Corn oil.jpg' is 704x1000 (below the size floor) and the rest are Mazola adverts/store shots, production maps and oil wells in corn fields. No plain unlabelled corn oil found.

ff_butter.author: Salicyna

alt.en: A block of butter on its opened wrapper
alt.ar: قالب زبدة على غلافه المفتوح

ff_butter.reviewNote: Three-quarter view of an unwrapped block of butter resting on its opened, plain foil-paper wrapper, in warm side light. Borderline on the 'packaging' rule: the wrapper is only the background, unprinted on this side, with no logo, brand or readable text. Every alternative found was a branded/wrapped pack, a dish being opened by a person, or butter on bread. Salted vs unsalted is not visible in any photo.

ff_ghee.reason: Previewed two: 'Ghee 2.jpg' (pale scraped ghee in a tub - unrecognisable, reads as ice cream) and 'Sliced clarified butter.png' (CC BY-SA 4.0, claimed own work; content is right - solid golden clarified butter in a bowl - but it is a recompressed, soft PNG at an odd 1147x867 size that looks lifted from the web, so provenance is doubtful). Other hits were ghee lamps, kettles, sweets and people/places named Ghee. A human could verify the PNG's provenance and reconsider.
